答案:
📌 參考答案
D. Z
D. Z
📌 詳細解釋
Z 是苔蘚植物，缺乏真正的根、莖、葉及維管組織，只能在潮濕和陰暗的環境中生存。
Z is a moss (bryophyte) which lacks true roots, stems, leaves, and vascular tissues, and can only survive in a moist and shady environment.
選項 A（被子植物）、B（裸子植物）及 C（蕨類）的植物具有維管組織，能適應較乾燥的環境。
The plants in options A (angiosperms), B (gymnosperms), and C (ferns) possess vascular tissues and can adapt to drier environments.
📌 考試提醒
苔蘚植物體積細小，並且依賴水膜進行游動精子的受精作用。
Bryophytes are small in size and rely on a film of water for the fertilization of motile sperms.
常見錯誤：未能辨識 Z 為苔蘚植物，或誤以為蕨類 (Y) 只能生存在極度潮濕的環境。
Common trap: Failing to identify Z as a moss, or mistakenly believing that ferns (Y) can only survive in extremely moist environments.

📌 參考答案
C. 只有W、X和Y
C. W, X and Y only
📌 詳細解釋
W 是一朵花（被子植物），X 和 Y 均顯示含有種子的構造，因此它們都能產生種子。
W is a flower (angiosperm), while X and Y both show seed-bearing structures, so they can all produce seeds.
Z 是苔蘚植物，以孢子繁殖，並不產生種子。
Z is a moss which reproduces by spores and does not produce seeds.
📌 考試提醒
被子植物（花）和裸子植物（毬果）均屬於種子植物。
Both angiosperms (flowers) and gymnosperms (cones) belong to seed plants.
常見錯誤：誤以為只有會開花的植物（W）才能產生種子，而忽略了裸子植物和其他形態的種子植物（X和Y）。
Common trap: Mistakenly believing that only flowering plants (W) produce seeds, ignoring gymnosperms and other forms of seed plants (X and Y).

📌 參考答案
A. 水母、蛇、兔
A. Jellyfish, Snake, Rabbit
📌 詳細解釋
P 沒有脊柱、鱗片和毛髮，符合無脊椎動物水母的特徵。
P lacks a vertebral column, scales, and hair, fitting the characteristics of an invertebrate jellyfish.
Q 有脊柱和鱗片但無毛髮，符合爬行動物如蛇和海龜的特徵。
Q has a vertebral column and scales but no hair, fitting the characteristics of reptiles like snakes and turtles.
R 有脊柱和毛髮，屬於哺乳動物，如兔或蝙蝠，因此只有選項 A 完全符合。
R has a vertebral column and hair, belonging to mammals like rabbits or bats, so only option A fully matches.
📌 考試提醒
毛髮（hair）是哺乳動物的獨有特徵，而羽毛（feathers）是鳥類的獨有特徵。
Hair is a unique characteristic of mammals, whereas feathers are unique to birds.
常見錯誤：混淆了鳥類的羽毛與哺乳類的毛髮（如選項 B 的雞）。
Common trap: Confusing the feathers of birds with the hair of mammals (e.g., chicken in option B).

📌 參考答案
C. 只有(1)和(3)
C. (1) and (3) only
📌 詳細解釋
在劇烈運動時，骨骼肌同時進行需氧呼吸 (3) 和缺氧呼吸 (1) 以提供額外能量。
During vigorous exercise, skeletal muscles carry out both aerobic respiration (3) and anaerobic respiration (1) to provide extra energy.
方程式 (2) 產生乙醇和二氧化碳，這是酵母菌及植物的缺氧呼吸，不會在人類骨骼肌發生。
Equation (2) produces ethanol and carbon dioxide, which is anaerobic respiration in yeast and plants, and does not occur in human skeletal muscles.
📌 考試提醒
人類骨骼肌的缺氧呼吸只會產生乳酸，不會產生二氧化碳。
Anaerobic respiration in human skeletal muscles only produces lactic acid and does not produce carbon dioxide.
常見錯誤：誤以為人體缺氧呼吸也會產生二氧化碳，或誤以為劇烈運動時只會進行缺氧呼吸。
Common trap: Mistakenly believing that human anaerobic respiration also produces carbon dioxide, or assuming only anaerobic respiration occurs during vigorous exercise.

📌 參考答案
B. 缺氧時，它為酵母菌提供能量。
B. It provides energy for yeast during a lack of oxygen.
📌 詳細解釋
當酵母菌無法獲得足夠氧氣時，缺氧呼吸能繼續提供維持生命過程所需的能量。
When yeast cannot obtain enough oxygen, anaerobic respiration continues to provide energy required for life processes.
選項 A 不是生理目的，選項 C 錯誤因為酵母菌在有氧時主要進行需氧呼吸。
Option A is not a physiological purpose, and option C is wrong because yeast mainly carries out aerobic respiration in the presence of oxygen.
📌 考試提醒
所有細胞呼吸作用的最終目的都是從食物中釋放能量以合成 ATP。
The ultimate purpose of all cellular respiration is to release energy from food to synthesize ATP.
常見錯誤：將副產品（如乙醇）的產生誤認為是缺氧呼吸對生物體本身的生理重要性。
Common trap: Mistaking the production of by-products (like ethanol) as the physiological importance of anaerobic respiration to the organism itself.

📌 參考答案
B. 只有Y
B. Y only
📌 詳細解釋
曲線圖顯示只有食物本質 Y 的未被消化百分率在胃部明顯下降，表示只有 Y 在胃部被消化。
The graph shows that only the percentage of undigested food substance of Y drops in the stomach, indicating that only Y is digested there.
食物本質 X 和 Z 在胃部內的未被消化百分率保持不變，沒有發生化學性消化。
The percentages of undigested food substances X and Z remain unchanged in the stomach, meaning no chemical digestion occurs.
📌 考試提醒
胃液含有胃蛋白酶，只能在酸性環境下初步消化蛋白質。
Gastric juice contains pepsin, which only initially digests proteins in an acidic environment.
常見錯誤：忽略了圖表的斜率下降代表該器官內正進行特定的化學性消化。
Common trap: Ignoring that a downward slope in the graph represents specific chemical digestion occurring in that organ.

📌 參考答案
A. 澱粉、蛋白質、脂肪
A. Starch, Protein, Fat
📌 詳細解釋
澱粉 (X) 在口腔開始被唾液澱粉酶消化，蛋白質 (Y) 在胃部開始被消化，而脂肪 (Z) 則在小腸才開始消化。
Starch (X) digestion begins in the mouth cavity by salivary amylase, protein (Y) digestion begins in the stomach, and fat (Z) digestion begins in the small intestine.
因此，X、Y 和 Z 分別完美對應澱粉、蛋白質和脂肪的消化起點。
Therefore, X, Y, and Z perfectly correspond to the starting digestion points of starch, protein, and fat respectively.
📌 考試提醒
小腸是所有三種主要食物本質完成消化及吸收的主要場所。
The small intestine is the main site where the digestion and absorption of all three main food substances are completed.
常見錯誤：未能熟記三大營養素在人體消化道各部位的化學性消化起點。
Common trap: Failing to memorize the starting points of chemical digestion for the three major nutrients along the human alimentary canal.

📌 參考答案
C. 小腸
C. Small intestine
📌 詳細解釋
小腸極長且內壁密佈絨毛，大大增加了表面積，使其成為消化道中吸收水分總量最多的部位。
The lengthy small intestine and its villi greatly increase the surface area, making it the part that absorbs the most water in the alimentary canal.
結腸的主要功能雖為吸收糞便中的水分，但由於其表面積遠小於小腸，實際吸收量不及小腸。
Although the main function of the colon is to absorb water from faeces, it actually absorbs less than the small intestine due to its much smaller surface area.
📌 考試提醒
水分在整個消化道中皆是透過滲透作用被動吸收的。
Water is passively absorbed throughout the alimentary canal by osmosis.
常見錯誤：受日常用語誤導，常識上誤以為結腸（大腸）吸收人體「最多」的水分。
Common trap: Misled by everyday language, relying on a common sense misconception that the colon (large intestine) absorbs the "most" water in the human body.

📌 參考答案
B. 它以最高速率進行光合作用。
B. It photosynthesizes at the maximum rate.
📌 詳細解釋
在 1200 小時，攝取氧的速率為最低負值（淨釋放氧氣），這代表此時光合作用速率不僅大於呼吸作用速率，更達到全日的最高峰。
At 1200 hours, the rate of oxygen uptake is at its lowest negative value (net oxygen liberation), meaning the photosynthetic rate is not only greater than the respiration rate but also reaches its daily peak.
選項 A 錯誤，因為呼吸作用全日無間斷進行。
Option A is wrong because respiration is carried out continuously throughout the day.
📌 考試提醒
淨氣體交換（釋放或攝取）取決於光合作用和呼吸作用兩者速率的相對大小。
Net gaseous exchange (liberation or uptake) depends on the relative magnitudes of the rates of photosynthesis and respiration.
常見錯誤：誤選 A，認為植物在日間有光照時會暫停呼吸作用。
Common trap: Mistakenly selecting option A, believing that plants temporarily halt respiration during the day when there is light.

📌 參考答案
C. 在24小時整段時間內，該植物的呼吸作用速率是恒定的。
C. The respiration rate of the plant remains constant throughout the 24-hour period.
📌 詳細解釋
攝取氧的速率等於呼吸作用速率減去光合作用速率。
The rate of oxygen uptake equals the rate of respiration minus the rate of photosynthesis.
若要推斷 1800 小時的光合作用速率為 3，必須先假定呼吸作用速率全日維持在夜間攝氧量（即 3 個單位）不變。
To deduce that the photosynthetic rate is 3 at 1800 hours, one must first assume the respiration rate remains constant at the night-time oxygen uptake level (i.e., 3 units) throughout the day.
📌 考試提醒
光強度的改變不會直接改變植物的基本呼吸作用速率。
Changes in light intensity do not directly alter the basic respiration rate of a plant.
常見錯誤：忽略了計算真實光合作用速率時，必須補回被同時進行的呼吸作用所消耗掉的氧氣量。
Common trap: Ignoring the fact that the amount of oxygen consumed by simultaneous respiration must be added back when calculating the true rate of photosynthesis.

📌 參考答案
B. 較細小的哺乳動物的代謝率較高。
B. Smaller mammals have a higher metabolic rate.
📌 詳細解釋
數據顯示，體型較細小的哺乳動物（如鼠）每單位身體質量的氧消耗率最高。
The data shows that smaller mammals (like mice) have the highest rate of oxygen consumption per unit body mass.
高氧消耗率反映牠們需要維持較高的呼吸作用速率，從而得出其代謝率較高的結論。
A high oxygen consumption rate reflects the need to maintain a higher respiration rate, concluding that they possess a higher metabolic rate.
📌 考試提醒
體型越小的恆溫動物，其表面積體積比越大，散失熱能越快，因此需要較高的代謝率來彌補熱能流失。
Homoiotherms with smaller body sizes have larger surface area to volume ratios, losing heat faster, and thus require a higher metabolic rate to compensate for heat loss.
常見錯誤：誤將「每單位質量的氧消耗率」與整體呼吸系統效率或心搏率混為一談，未深入至細胞代謝層面。
Common trap: Confusing "oxygen consumption rate per unit mass" with overall respiratory system efficiency or heart rate, failing to dive into the cellular metabolic level.

📌 參考答案
C. 根毛細胞吸收礦物質
C. Absorption of minerals by root hair cells
📌 詳細解釋
根毛細胞除了透過擴散作用外，還會利用主動運輸來逆濃度梯度吸收礦物鹽，此過程必須消耗由呼吸作用釋出的能量。
Besides diffusion, root hair cells also use active transport to absorb mineral salts against a concentration gradient, a process that must consume energy released from respiration.
蒸騰牽引力 (A)、細胞間的滲透作用 (B) 及蒸騰作用散失水分 (D) 均屬於被動過程，不需消耗 ATP。
Transpiration pull (A), intercellular osmosis (B), and water loss via transpiration (D) are passive processes that do not consume ATP.
📌 考試提醒
主動運輸是唯一需要依賴細胞活體呼吸作用提供能量的物質跨膜運輸方式。
Active transport is the only form of transmembrane transport of substances that relies on energy provided by respiration in living cells.
常見錯誤：錯誤以為植物體內水分的被動運輸（如木質部內的上升）需要消耗植物自身的化學能。
Common trap: Mistakenly believing that the passive transport of water in plants (like ascending in xylem) requires the consumption of the plant's own chemical energy.

📌 參考答案
D. 肝靜脈，大靜脈，腎靜脈
D. Hepatic vein, vena cava, renal vein
📌 詳細解釋
肝臟進行脫氨基作用產生尿素，因此剛離開肝臟的肝靜脈含有最高濃度的尿素。
Deamination in the liver produces urea, so the hepatic vein just leaving the liver contains the highest concentration of urea.
大靜脈收集了來自全身的血液，產生稀釋效應；而血液流經腎臟後大部分尿素被排走，故離開腎臟的腎靜脈尿素濃度最低。
The vena cava collects blood from the whole body, creating a dilution effect; after blood passes through the kidneys, most urea is removed, making the renal vein leaving the kidneys have the lowest urea concentration.
📌 考試提醒
排泄廢物的產生源頭與排泄出口的血管成分差異是 DSE 經典考點。
The differences in blood vessel composition between the source of excretory waste and the excretory exit are a classic DSE examination point.
常見錯誤：將腎動脈與腎靜脈的功能混淆，誤以為離開排泄器官的血液會累積最多代謝廢物。
Common trap: Confusing the functions of the renal artery and renal vein, mistakenly thinking blood leaving an excretory organ accumulates the most代謝廢物。

📌 參考答案
C. 氣孔開得越大，蒸騰速率越高。
C. The wider the stomata open, the higher the transpiration rate.
📌 詳細解釋
從曲線圖可以直接觀察到單一變量關係：隨着 X 軸的氣孔大小增加，Y 軸的氣孔蒸騰速率在兩種空氣條件下均隨之上升。
A single-variable relationship can be directly observed from the graph: as the stomatal size on the X-axis increases, the stomatal transpiration rate on the Y-axis rises under both air conditions.
其他選項雖屬正確生物學概念，但無法單憑此特定曲線圖的數據直接演繹。
Although other options are correct biological concepts, they cannot be directly deduced solely from the data of this specific graph.
📌 考試提醒
作答「數據推論題」時，結論必須且只能建基於圖表所提供的坐標軸變數關係。
When answering "data inference questions", the conclusion must and can only be based on the relationship of the coordinate axis variables provided by the graph.
常見錯誤：過度推論，選擇了事實上正確但圖表數據並未提供的外在結論（如選項 A 或 B）。
Common trap: Over-inferring by choosing external conclusions that are factually correct but not provided by the graph's data (e.g., options A or B).

📌 參考答案
C. 只有(1)和(3)
C. (1) and (3) only
📌 詳細解釋
耳蝸 (1) 內含有感覺毛細胞以探測聲波頻率；半規管 (3) 的壺腹內亦有感覺毛細胞以探測頭部移動及平衡。
The cochlea (1) contains sensory hair cells to detect sound wave frequencies; the ampullae of the semi-circular canals (3) also contain sensory hair cells to detect head movements and balance.
鼓膜 (2) 是一層結締組織薄膜，只負責將聲波震動物理傳遞至聽骨，不含任何感覺受器細胞。
The eardrum (2) is a thin connective tissue membrane that only physically transmits sound wave vibrations to the ear ossicles and contains no sensory receptor cells.
📌 考試提醒
感覺細胞的作用是將外界的物理或化學刺激轉化為神經脈衝。
The function of sensory cells is to convert external physical or chemical stimuli into nerve impulses.
常見錯誤：把內耳負責接收刺激的受器（如耳蝸）與中耳負責傳導震動的物理構造（如鼓膜）混淆。
Common trap: Confusing the receptors in the inner ear responsible for receiving stimuli (like the cochlea) with the physical structures in the middle ear responsible for conducting vibrations (like the eardrum).

📌 參考答案
D. 他會變為不育。
D. He would become sterile.
📌 詳細解釋
輸精管被結紮及切斷後，睪丸製造的精子無法運送至尿道，因此射出的精液中不含精子，導致不育。
After the sperm ducts are tied and cut, sperms produced by the testes cannot be transported to the urethra, leaving the ejaculated semen sperm-free and resulting in sterility.
由於睪丸仍繼續運作，且性激素是透過血液而非輸精管運輸，因此第二性徵（如聲音音調）完全不受影響。
Since the testes continue to function and sex hormones are transported through the blood rather than sperm ducts, secondary sexual characteristics (like voice pitch) are completely unaffected.
📌 考試提醒
結紮手術純粹阻斷配子（精子）的物理離開路徑，不干擾內分泌系統的運作。
Ligation surgery purely blocks the physical exit pathway of gametes (sperms) and does not interfere with the operation of the endocrine system.
常見錯誤：誤以為切斷輸精管等同於切除睪丸（閹割），會導致男性性激素停止分泌及特徵改變。
Common trap: Mistakenly believing that cutting the sperm ducts is equivalent to removing the testes (castration), which would stop the secretion of male sex hormones and alter characteristics.

📌 參考答案
D. 氣溫
D. Air temperature
📌 詳細解釋
由 0800 至 1400 小時之間，隨着太陽輻射增強，氣溫極有可能上升，導致葉片表面水分蒸發速率加快，從而直接提高蒸騰速率。
Between 0800 and 1400 hours, as solar radiation strengthens, the air temperature is highly likely to rise, accelerating the water evaporation rate from the leaf surface and directly increasing the transpiration rate.
植物吸水速率的增加是被動地由蒸騰牽引力增強所引致，因果不可倒置（選項 A 錯誤）。
The increase in plant water absorption rate is passively caused by the strengthened transpiration pull; the cause and effect cannot be inverted (option A is wrong).
📌 考試提醒
蒸騰作用是一個物理性的被動蒸發過程，深刻受到環境因素（如光強度、溫度、相對濕度）主導。
Transpiration is a physical passive evaporation process deeply governed by environmental factors (such as light intensity, temperature, and relative humidity).
常見錯誤：將植物吸水的結果當成推動蒸騰作用的原因，完全倒果為因。
Common trap: Treating the result of plant water absorption as the cause driving transpiration, completely inverting cause and effect.

📌 參考答案
B. 1200小時
B. 1200 hours
📌 詳細解釋
當蒸騰速率的曲線圖（實線）位於吸收速率（虛線）之上方時，代表該植物的失水速率實質上高於其吸水速率。
When the graph for transpiration rate (solid line) is above that of absorption rate (dotted line), it means the plant's actual rate of water loss is higher than its rate of water uptake.
在 1200 小時，實線明顯高於虛線，顯示植物正處於淨失水狀態。
At 1200 hours, the solid line is clearly above the dotted line, showing that the plant is in a state of net water loss.
📌 考試提醒
圖表題中兩條曲線的垂直相對位置代表了淨變化率的正負值。
The vertical relative position of two curves in a graph question represents the positive or negative value of the net rate of change.
常見錯誤：看錯圖例，或誤判曲線最高點與交匯點的相對意義，未能準確讀取特定時間點的淨得失。
Common trap: Misreading the legend, or misjudging the relative meaning of the peaks and intersections of the curves, failing to accurately read the net gain/loss at a specific time point.

📌 參考答案
C. 該植物生長時形成新的細胞。
C. The plant forms new cells during growth.
📌 詳細解釋
圖表中面積 B 大於面積 A 代表該植物全日錄得淨水分增加，這些額外儲存的水分被抽取至生長區域的組織中以提供細胞硬脹，促進細胞伸長。
Area B being greater than Area A in the graph means the plant recorded a net water gain over the day; this extra stored water is drawn into tissues in growth regions to provide cell turgor, promoting cell elongation.
這證明植物吸收的水分並非 100% 經蒸騰作用流失，有少量必須保留在體內作生長及代謝之用。
This proves that the water absorbed by the plant is not 100% lost through transpiration; a small amount must be retained in the body for growth and metabolism.
📌 考試提醒
植物吸水的主要用途是補充蒸騰流失，但細胞硬脹支持及光合作用作為反應物也是不可或缺的功用。
The main purpose of plant water absorption is to replenish transpiration loss, but providing cell turgidity support and acting as a reactant in photosynthesis are also indispensable functions.
